blind_target.title: Promoting positive feelings and motivation for language learning: The role of a confidence-building diary.
blind_target.evidence_quote: The original investigation conducted by Shelton-Strong and Mynard (2018, 2021) on the use of a confidence-building diary with university students was replicated with younger students aged 13–14 years old (Spricigo, 2023).
blind_target.outcome_quote: In the original study, all the participants felt that the CBD-based intervention was beneficial. In the replication study, although the CBD was generally well-received, a minority of participants did not find it motivating.
blind_target.outcome_reasoning: Positive feelings and basic need satisfaction agree, but authors explicitly contrast preferred receptive activities with original speaking preference and contrast universal original benefit with a minority not motivated. Conclusion endorses effectiveness of the tool, rather than issuing an overall verdict on all replication findings.

luna_triage.reason: The article directly says it replicates Shelton-Strong and Mynard (2018, 2021), and the supplied shipped row is the 2018 work. The source treats the two citations jointly as “the original study” and gives no distinction between which findings came from which report. Given the publication-level deduplication rule, it is unresolved whether the 2021 DOI is a separate empirical original or another report of the same original work. Need evidence distinguishing the studies/reports and their findings.
luna_triage.location: Abstract; introduction; comparison of original and replication findings; references
